units: SI; angles rad; heatFlux W/m²; temperature K; inertia kg·m²

integrator.translation: central gravity / explicit forces / trapezoid velocity
integrator.attitude: I omegaDot = torque - omega cross I omega; explicit midpoint / body quaternion exponential map; co-rotating mass outflow

rigidModel.bodyAxes: Y nose/roll, Z primary pitch, X crossrange pitch/yaw; quaternions xyzw body-to-world
rigidModel.inertia: diagonal tensor with 1.2% transverse asymmetry; fixed effective mass distribution
rigidModel.engineTorque: each engine position cross exact gimballed force
rigidModel.aero: drag at direction-dependent pressure centre plus rotational damping; passive aerodynamic torque survives fuel exhaustion
rigidModel.contact: tower capture window or orientation-dependent hull first intersection

gpuEvidence.note: CPU records inputs; actual GPU execution is separately read back in browser tests.
